# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Rises from the Jordan

---

**8:1** When Adam heard these words of the devil he wept and cried out and said: 'O Lord my God, my life is in your hands. Make this adversary be far from me, who seeks to lead my soul astray, and give me his glory which he lost.'

**8:2** And the Lord heard Adam's prayer and sent Michael the archangel, and he cast the devil far from Adam.

**8:3** And the archangel Michael said to Adam: 'Rise up, Adam, and come up from the water. The Lord has heard your penance and has forgiven you; he will restore you to paradise with all the commands.'

**8:4** And Adam came out of the water and his flesh was like the withered grass from the cold of the water.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
